decoration.tagTransformConvention: Figma rotations are top-left anchored and use the supplied relativeTransform matrices. Map geometry into native coordinates; do not assume the same numeric angle sign with a center-anchored native rotation.

prototypeContract.intent: Required actual typed Wristband value; no Social or other default
prototypeContract.selectedTap: No-op; no clearing or replaying motion
prototypeContract.back: Actual Wristband with current intent and approach preserved
prototypeContract.intentChange: Update carried band and intent label; preserve approach and attached pose
prototypeContract.memory: One onboarding-session draft, in memory only; no relaunch persistence
prototypeContract.continueWithApproach: Native dismissible “End of this preview.” with OK until a separately approved Places handoff
prototypeContract.returnFixtureLimitation: Figma same-page Wristband copies reset approach to empty; this is not the native preservation contract
prototypeContract.consent: Current approach preference is not continuing consent; either person may change their mind. Later chat still requires deliberate Wave initiation and acceptance.

firstSelection.nativeBehavior: 2D tag translation/straightening only; group native icon with tag artwork; keep band stationary

preferenceSwitch.nativeBehavior: Retain attached tag pose; dissolve preference state

motion.reentry: Retain existing selection and attached pose; do not replay first attachment
motion.reduceMotion: Instant final pose/state, including changes while a decorative transition is active
motion.modelUpdate: Immediate; never wait for decorative motion completion
motion.limitations: No 3D rig, physical clipping/occlusion, depth model, clasp articulation or hardware connection

a11yIntent.largerText: Wrap descriptions, grow rows and scroll content; keep controls reachable in safe areas

measuredExport.source: Read from approved Figma frames without mutating them
